title: MPSC Order — Case No. U-20958: Grants the application
text:
S T A T E O F M I C H I G A N 

BEFORE THE MICHIGAN PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 

* * * * * 

In the matter of the application of
) 
CHARTER FIBERLINK – MICHIGAN, LLC, 
) 
for designation as an eligible telecommunications
)
Case No. U-20958 
carrier in the state of Michigan.
) 
) 

At the November 4, 2021 meeting of the Michigan Public Service Commission in Lansing, 
Michigan. 

PRESENT: Hon. Daniel C. Scripps, Chair 

Hon. Tremaine L. Phillips, Commissioner 

Hon. Katherine L. Peretick, Commissioner 

ORDER 

On January 6, 2021, Charter Fiberlink - Michigan, LLC (Charter) filed an application (January 
6 application) pursuant to Section 214(e)(2) of the federal Communications Act of 1934, 47 USC 
214(e)(2), for designation as an eligible telecommunications carrier (ETC) for access to universal 
service fund support for the purpose of expanding and enhancing its rural broadband network. 
Charter filed supplemental documents on April 28, 2021 (April 28 supplemental filing). On May 
26, 2021, the Commission issued an order (May 26 order) approving Charter’s application as a 
High Cost ETC and Lifeline ETC. Charter was designated by the Commission as an ETC 
throughout the census blocks listed in Exhibit A-1 of the January 6 application. The census blocks 
listed in Exhibit A-1 were awarded to Charter by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) 
as a result of the Rural Digital Opportunity Fund (RDOF) auction program. 

Page 2 
U-20958 

On October 18, 2021, Charter filed an application (October 18 application), with supporting 
exhibits, to amend the service area that was previously granted in the May 26 order. Charter seeks 
to correct the current designated service area to reflect the appropriate census blocks that Charter 
was awarded in the RDOF auction. The January 6 application was filed before the FCC publicly 
listed the specific census blocks awarded to Charter in the RDOF auction and, as such, Charter’s 
list of awarded census blocks related to the RDOF auction was created with preliminary data. On 
July 26, 2021, the FCC released the updated census block information.1 In its October 18 
application, Charter seeks to amend its ETC service area, removing census blocks that it was not 
officially awarded. See, Exhibits 1 and 2 of the October 18 application. Charter is not seeking to 
remove any census blocks that includes Tribal land. 

Charter is currently a licensed provider of basic local exchange service in the state of 
Michigan. 

Charter has committed to using any federal High Cost support it receives only for the 
provision, construction, maintenance, and upgrading of facilities and provision of supported 
services in the service area for which support is intended. 

After reviewing Charter’s October 18 application, the Commission finds that the application to 
amend the ETC service area and designation as requested will further the interest of the consumer 
and should be granted. The Commission also finds that all other aspects of the original May 26 
order remain in effect and that Charter shall continue to meet all ETC and RDOF requirements. 

1 See, https://www.fcc.gov/auction/904/round-results. 

Page 3 
U-20958 

THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED that the application filed by Charter Fiberlink - Michigan, 
LLC, to amend its eligible telecommunications carrier designation to include all census blocks 
listed in Exhibit 2 of its October 18, 2021 application is granted. 

The Commission reserves jurisdiction and may issue further orders as necessary. 

Page 4 
U-20958 

Any party aggrieved by this order may file an action in the appropriate federal District Court 
pursuant to 28 USC 1331. To notify the Commission of an appeal, appellants shall send required 
notices to both the Commission’s Executive Secretary and to the Commission’s Legal Counsel. 
Electronic notifications should be sent to the Executive Secretary at mpscedockets@michigan.gov 
and to the Michigan Department of the Attorney General - Public Service Division at 
pungp1@michigan.gov. In lieu of electronic submissions, paper copies of such notifications may 
be sent to the Executive Secretary and Attorney General - Public Service Division at 
7109 W. Saginaw Hwy., Lansing, MI 48917.
